title: City Council District 7
statement: The first quarter utilization review for the Temescal Community Health Center must anchor directly to line-item audit standards, tracking intake efficiency against the 102 sick residents in Temescal, 110 in Rockridge, and 18 in KONO. Operational status is a baseline, not an achievement; District 7 will audit every service delivery metric and verify that the remaining $17,653,846.15 allocation produces measurable recovery across our corridors.
numberMoved: INIT-005 first quarter utilization review audited against 102 sick residents in Temescal
